oracle: the labelled multi-Bernoulli filter (Reuter, Vo, Vo and Dietmayer 2014): the exact delta-GLMB update of an LMB prior, projected back onto an LMB by moment matching, with the association marginals produced by LITERAL enumeration of every association event -- see the module docstring for the derivation and for the five independent checks run before this file was written
filter_built: LMB (labelled multi-Bernoulli), not the full delta-GLMB
what_is_approximated: the single-scan update is exact in every per-label marginal; the projection back onto an LMB discards the inter-label dependence of the delta-GLMB posterior, so the error is what the NEXT scan inherits. Measured, not asserted: delta_glmb_existence_gap_per_scan
stonesoup_status: no GLMB and no LMB exist in stonesoup 1.9.1 -- not partial, absent: zero modules named for one, zero source lines in the whole package mentioning GLMB/LMB/labelled-multi-Bernoulli, and 3 of 3 plausible import paths ModuleNotFoundError. The nearest neighbours are the SINGLE-target BernoulliParticleUpdater and the unlabelled PHDUpdater/LCCUpdater
method_note: Per label: the existence probability, and the spatial density as a FUNCTION at fixed probe points -- never the component list, for the same reason the PHD and CPHD rows give. The LABEL SET is compared exactly, because label identity is the entire reason this row is separate from the PHD/CPHD one.
